author: Slidebean
description:
The real reason non consensual deepfake tools keep surviving.

Clothoff didn’t survive because platforms failed to ban it.
It survived because bans aren’t enough anymore.

Web distribution, Telegram bots, and anonymous operators create a system with no clear point of enforcement.
Even when content is removed, it reappears within hours.

This case exposes a growing gap between how fast harmful tech spreads and how slow legal accountability moves.

title: Why banning deepfake apps isn’t working
